purpose: Define start, stop, reload and failure states for listener instances without conflating configured binding with active runtime availability.

topics.name: Network Listener Lifecycle
topics.purpose: Define start, stop, reload and failure states for listener instances without conflating configured binding with active runtime availability.

semantics.start_rule: Start targets exact listener identity and validated binding.
semantics.stop_rule: Stop targets exact active listener/runtime instance.
semantics.reload_rule: Binding/config changes require explicit rebind/reload semantics.
semantics.availability_rule: Listening means transport acceptance only, not application readiness/authorization.

invariants.rule: Listener, route, endpoint, connection, channel, peer reachability and cryptographic transport evidence never by themselves grant application, data or operation authority.
Inbound network data remains inert until explicit protocol parsing, validation, identity/context resolution, authorization and dispatcher routing succeed.

hard_gates.condition: stop by port kills unrelated listener
